The handoff states: 'The five that remain (ChiefChilly, Crate, Coin, Player, daGmch_c) carry the same values on origin/main, so they are not this branch's to move and were left alone.' Running 'python tools/queue_audit.py' at base c52f63ca5342b2701006db5022146e93afc305e4 gives 2 disagreeing rows, not 5: ChiefChilly and Player only. The sentence is defensible on a narrow reading of 'carry the same values', because the STATED cells for Crate, Coin and daGmch_c are indeed unchanged from main; but the conclusion it draws, 'not this branch's to move', is false, because the branch's own edits moved the MEASURED side (-4, -1, +1 lines respectively). A reader is left believing the residue is inherited when three fifths of it is branch-caused, which is exactly the bar that handoff-matching-headers-claim-false established for this task. FIX: reword 125-127 to say two rows (ChiefChilly, Player) are pre-existing and identical at c52f63ca5342b2701006db5022146e93afc305e4, and that Crate, Coin and daGmch_c were made stale by this branch and have been refreshed to 1427, 1147 and 1120.
